package.name: slam_ros2
package.description: ROS2 wrapper for the slam project's VIO/LiDAR/backend/mapping pipeline. Depends on slam_core (this repo's main library) via a plain find_package(slam CONFIG REQUIRED), not rosdep -- see PHASE6_PLAN.md section 3.6 and README.md's ROS2 section for how to make it discoverable (CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH after `cmake --install`).
